iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.desc: Raw ore chipped from a dungeon vein. The smith turns it into gear.

lore.text: Rust-red streaks mean it's rich; grey means mostly rock. Three good lumps make a blade.
Quench it in oil, not water, and the edge holds longer.

spirit_herb.name: Spirit Herb
spirit_herb.desc: A pale herb that drinks ambient qi. Brewed into salves and pills.

lore.text: The pale ones growing in shadow are the potent ones.
Crushed with clean water it closes wounds -- the base of every salve.
Dried slowly over a low fire, its qi stays bound instead of bleeding away -- pills made from it come out stronger.

goblin_tooth.name: Goblin Tooth
goblin_tooth.desc: Proof of a goblin killed. The merchant buys them by the handful.

lore.text: Goblins chew qi-stained roots all their lives. The tooth keeps some of it -- a catalyst, not a meal.

bone_shard.name: Bone Shard
bone_shard.desc: Dense, qi-stained bone from the crypt dead.

lore.text: Crypt bone is denser than it should be. Lacquered, it turns a blade like plate.
Ground fine, it steadies a volatile pill.

silver_ore.name: Silver Ore
silver_ore.desc: Bright ore from the deep mine. Holds a spirit edge.

lore.text: Silver drinks qi the way water drinks heat. Deep veins are purer.
Soft enough to set a stone in; worth more as a ring than as a sword.

nanite_shard.name: Nanite Shard
nanite_shard.desc: A sliver of the old machines. The nanites inside still hum when qi passes through them.

lore.text: Folded into steel, the nanites keep rebuilding the edge between swings.
Dissolved in a pill, they carry qi straight into the meridians. Dangerous. Effective.

warden_core.name: Warden Core
warden_core.desc: The heart of the Corrupted Warden. Something inside it is still thinking.

lore.text: It still thinks. A blade built around it would think too.

bone_blade.name: Bone Blade
bone_blade.desc: Carved from crypt bone, light and cruel. +10 damage.

spirit_steel_sword.name: Spirit Steel Sword
spirit_steel_sword.desc: Silver folded with nanite shards; it channels qi into the cut. +16 damage.

nanite_edge.name: Nanite Edge
nanite_edge.desc: A blade the nanites rebuild between every swing. +28 damage.

bone_mail.name: Bone Mail
bone_mail.desc: Lacquered crypt bone, lighter than iron. +90 max HP.

nanite_weave.name: Nanite Weave
nanite_weave.desc: A living mesh that knits itself shut. +160 max HP.

lore.text: Apply to the wound, not the skin around it. Made with care it heals more.

qi_pill.name: Qi Gathering Pill
qi_pill.desc: Floods the meridians with refined qi. +80 qi. (Key 2)

lore.text: Taken while meditating, none of its qi is wasted.

breakthrough_pill.name: Breakthrough Pill
breakthrough_pill.desc: A pill for the moment a realm wall cracks. +400 qi.

storage_ring.name: Qiankun Ring
storage_ring.where: Trader Wen sells it; the fountain gives it for the 33rd coin
storage_ring.desc: A plain iron ring, bigger inside than out. Your pouch holds 99 of each material instead of 20, and the gold inside it isn't lost when you fall.

spirit_gourd.name: Spirit Gourd
spirit_gourd.desc: A gourd of spring water that never quite runs dry. Key 3: drink (heals 40% of your HP). Holds 3 sips; it refills when you sit at a shrine.

flying_sword.name: Azure Flying Sword
flying_sword.desc: A sword that answers the mind instead of the hand. Key G: it leaves your side, strikes the nearest enemy within 14 m, and comes home.

jade_pendant.name: Pendant of Nine Breaths
jade_pendant.desc: Green jade, warm as skin. Qi gathers to it: +25% qi from everything, and sitting to cultivate is half again as fast.

lotus_seat.name: Nanite Lotus Seat
lotus_seat.desc: A folding seat of living metal petals. Wherever you sit on it, you cultivate as if at a shrine.

rough_jade.name: Rough Jade
rough_jade.desc: A green stone that feels warmer than the rock around it.

lore.text: Jade holds Earth qi; set in silver it steadies the body that wears it.
It grows where old roots pressed on stone for a thousand years.

rough_ruby.name: Rough Ruby
rough_ruby.desc: A red crystal with a spark caught somewhere inside.

lore.text: Fire qi, barely held. In gold it sharpens a strike.
Water qi. Worn close to the heart it slows the breath and deepens meditation.

gold_nugget.name: Gold Nugget
gold_nugget.desc: Soft, heavy, and everyone wants it.

lore.text: Too soft for a blade; perfect for holding a stone.

ember_root.name: Ember Root
ember_root.desc: A twisted red root, warm to the touch even underground.

lore.text: Grows where the earth runs hot. Never eat it raw.
Refined with a spirit herb, its heat becomes Fire qi you can hold.

moonpetal.name: Moonpetal
moonpetal.desc: A pale flower that only opens away from light.

lore.text: It drinks damp air; flooded places grow the best of it.
Steeped, it cools a fever and knits flesh faster than any salve.

iron_thistle.name: Iron Thistle
iron_thistle.desc: A grey thistle whose spines ring faintly when you flick them.

lore.text: It pulls iron out of the soil into its spines.
Its spines, ground, make a pill that hardens the body like tempered steel.

cave_carp.name: Cave Carp
cave_carp.desc: Pale, blind, and better eating than it looks.

lore.text: They feed at the bottom; let the line sink.
The oil of its liver closes wounds.

glowfin_eel.name: Glowfin Eel
glowfin_eel.desc: A slippery eel with faint blue light along its fins.

lore.text: Only bites in deep, still water -- and only for the patient.
The glow is qi. Dried and powdered, it carries into a pill.

jade_ring.name: Jade Ring
jade_ring.desc: Silver around a jade stone. The wearer stands steadier. (+6% HP)

ruby_ring.name: Ruby Ring
ruby_ring.desc: Gold around a ruby. Strikes land a little hotter. (+7% damage)

sapphire_amulet.name: Sapphire Amulet
sapphire_amulet.desc: Cold against the skin. Cultivation comes easier. (+20% meditation)

gold_amulet.name: Gold Amulet
gold_amulet.desc: Plain gold, heavy, warm. Qi gathers to it. (+5% qi)

ember_pill.name: Ember Pill
ember_pill.desc: Burns going down. +60 qi, and a little Fire settles in you.

moonpetal_tonic.name: Moonpetal Tonic
moonpetal_tonic.desc: Cool and bitter. Heals 120 HP; a little Water settles in you.

thistle_pill.name: Iron Thistle Pill
thistle_pill.desc: Like swallowing a nail. +40 qi; Metal and Earth settle in you.

carp_oil_salve.name: Carp-Oil Salve
carp_oil_salve.desc: Smells of the river. Heals 90 HP.

beast_hide.name: Beast Hide
beast_hide.desc: A rough hide, still smelling of the tunnels.

lore.text: Skinned cleanly, a hide is worth twice as much.
Stitched in layers it turns a blade almost as well as iron, and weighs nothing.
Boiled down with a herb it makes a broth that mends far better than it tastes.

hide_vest.name: Hide Vest
hide_vest.desc: Layered hides, stitched tight. +40 max HP.

bone_broth.name: Hunter's Broth
bone_broth.desc: Thick and warming. Heals 80 HP; a little Earth settles in you.

spirit_resin.name: Spirit Resin
spirit_resin.desc: Amber sap that bled from a tree with a cultivator's roots.

lore.text: Spread thin over a wound, it seals and breathes at the same time.
It carries Wood qi without spoiling. Pills built on it keep for years.

heartwood.name: Spirit Heartwood
heartwood.desc: The dense, warm core of a grove tree. It is faintly alive.

lore.text: Hard as iron along the grain. A spear shaft of it never splinters.

verdant_heart.name: Verdant Heart
verdant_heart.desc: The Grove Mother's seed. It beats, slowly, like a sleeping thing.

lore.text: One heart, ground fine, could feed a whole sect's pills for a year -- or one person's breakthrough.

firestone.name: Firestone
firestone.desc: A red stone, warm to hold, warmer the longer you hold it.

lore.text: Set in silver it burns steady; set in gold it burns bright.
A pinch of it in a pill makes the qi go down like a swallowed coal.

slag_iron.name: Slag Iron
slag_iron.desc: Iron that has been through the Ember Forges too many times. Black, heavy, stubborn.

lore.text: Fold it with firestone and it forgets it was ever brittle.

sovereign_ember.name: Sovereign Ember
sovereign_ember.desc: A coal that has never gone out. Something in it remembers being a king.

lore.text: A furnace fed with it can melt what no other fire can.

ancient_clay.name: Ancient Clay
ancient_clay.desc: Fired clay from the buried army, still holding the shape of a soldier's hand.

lore.text: Crushed and bound, it makes scale armour lighter than iron and almost as hard.

emperor_jade.name: Emperor's Jade
emperor_jade.desc: Deep green jade from the barrows. The carvings on it are orders.

lore.text: Jade that has given orders still wants to. Worn, it steadies the wearer.

imperial_seal.name: Imperial Seal
imperial_seal.desc: The Buried Emperor's seal. Press it to clay and the clay stands up.

lore.text: Set in a halberd's head, it makes the weapon an order no one can refuse.

grave_steel.name: Grave Steel
grave_steel.desc: Steel from a sword that was buried with its master. It still has an edge.

lore.text: Every piece remembers a different sword. Fold enough of them together and they argue -- then agree.

sword_intent_shard.name: Sword Intent Shard
sword_intent_shard.desc: A splinter of pure intent, cold and bright. It cuts the hand that doubts it.

lore.text: Forge it into a blade only when you know exactly what the blade is for.

thornwood_spear.name: Thornwood Spear
thornwood_spear.desc: A heartwood shaft bound with resin, its tip a living thorn. +32 damage.

firestone_saber.name: Firestone Saber
firestone_saber.desc: Slag iron folded around a vein of firestone. It glows when it swings. +38 damage.

emperors_halberd.name: Emperor's Halberd
emperors_halberd.desc: A clay-army halberd reforged with jade. Soldiers would kneel to it. +44 damage.

grave_sword.name: Sword of the Grave
grave_sword.desc: Five buried swords become one, and the one has made up its mind. +52 damage.

barkskin_mail.name: Barkskin Mail
barkskin_mail.desc: Plates of heartwood sealed in resin. It grows back where it's cut. +200 max HP.

slag_plate.name: Slag Plate
slag_plate.desc: Black, heavy, ugly, and it has never once broken. +250 max HP.

terracotta_scale.name: Terracotta Scale
terracotta_scale.desc: Clay scales from the buried army, jade-bound. +320 max HP.

resin_salve.name: Resin Salve
resin_salve.desc: Seals a wound and lets it breathe. Heals 160 HP; a little Wood settles in you.

verdant_pill.name: Verdant Pill
verdant_pill.desc: Tastes of green things growing. +120 qi, and Wood settles in you.

magma_pill.name: Magma Pill
magma_pill.desc: Goes down like a swallowed coal. +160 qi, and Fire settles in you.

earthmarrow_pill.name: Earthmarrow Pill
earthmarrow_pill.desc: Heavy as a stone in the belly. +200 qi, and Earth settles in you.

sword_qi_pill.name: Sword Qi Pill
sword_qi_pill.desc: It cuts on the way down. +260 qi, and Metal settles in you.

shell_tea.name: Shellhaven Tea
shell_tea.desc: Brewed from the moss that grows on the tortoise's shell. Heals 90 HP; a little Water settles in you.

firestone_ring.name: Firestone Ring
firestone_ring.desc: A firestone in a silver band. Your strikes land hotter. (+6% damage)

emperor_jade_pendant.name: Emperor's Jade Pendant
emperor_jade_pendant.desc: A carved order hung at the throat: STAND. (+10% HP)

tortoise_scale.name: Scale of the Sleeping Tortoise
tortoise_scale.desc: A scale the old tortoise shed a thousand years ago, still warm with its slow breath. You take less damage, and cultivate a little deeper.

saints_sheath.name: The Sword Saint's Sheath
saints_sheath.desc: An empty sheath that still knows the shape of the greatest sword ever drawn. Whatever you carry, it draws faster and cuts deeper.

goblin_shiv.name: Goblin Shiv
goblin_shiv.desc: A notched blade a goblin kept very, very sharp.

chipped_hatchet.name: Chipped Hatchet
chipped_hatchet.desc: A woodcutter's hatchet. The goblins found other uses for it.

goblin_leathers.name: Goblin Leathers
goblin_leathers.desc: Stitched hides, stiff with old sweat. Better than nothing. +30 max HP.

bone_spear.name: Bone Spear
bone_spear.desc: A thighbone shaft with a sharpened shoulder blade bound to the tip.

knight_longsword.name: Knight's Longsword
knight_longsword.desc: Carried by a skeleton knight for longer than you have been alive.

shroud_mail.name: Shroud Mail
shroud_mail.desc: Mail links woven through a burial shroud. Cold. +70 max HP.

miners_pick.name: Miner's Pick
miners_pick.desc: A heavy pick that broke stone for twenty years and bones for a few more.

drowned_hook.name: Drowned Man's Hook
drowned_hook.desc: A curved hook-blade, still dripping no matter how long it dries.

miner_leathers.name: Miner's Leathers
miner_leathers.desc: Thick apron and cap, studded at the shoulders. +100 max HP.

warden_staff.name: Warden's Staff
warden_staff.desc: A rod of living metal; the nanites in it lean toward your qi. (+8% qi)

sentinel_halberd.name: Sentinel Halberd
sentinel_halberd.desc: Too heavy for a person. The sentinels weren't people.

sentinel_plate.name: Sentinel Plate
sentinel_plate.desc: A plate shed by a sanctum sentinel, refitted for something smaller. +150 max HP.

rootwood_staff.name: Rootwood Staff
rootwood_staff.desc: A grove root that kept growing after it was cut. Kills feed it -- and you. (+4 HP per kill)

thorn_knuckles.name: Thorn Knuckles
thorn_knuckles.desc: Wraps studded with living thorns. Fast, and they bite.

thornweave_vest.name: Thornweave Vest
thornweave_vest.desc: A vest of woven vines that tightens when you're struck. +190 max HP.

imp_fang_daggers.name: Imp-Fang Daggers
imp_fang_daggers.desc: A pair of blades cut from cinder imps' fangs. Still warm.

slag_maul.name: Slag Maul
slag_maul.desc: A lump of slag iron on a beam. Subtle it is not.

forgeguard_mail.name: Forgeguard Mail
forgeguard_mail.desc: Smith's mail, scorched and riveted twice over. +240 max HP.

clay_general_glaive.name: Clay General's Glaive
clay_general_glaive.desc: The general's own glaive, fired in the kiln with him.

jade_guard_sabre.name: Jade-Guard Sabre
jade_guard_sabre.desc: A sabre with a jade guard carved with an order: ADVANCE.

clay_lamellar.name: Clay Lamellar
clay_lamellar.desc: Hundreds of fired-clay plates on silk cords. +300 max HP.

wraith_blade.name: Wraith Blade
wraith_blade.desc: A sword a wraith would not let go of. It is light, and it is eager.

keeper_greataxe.name: Keeper's Greataxe
keeper_greataxe.desc: A grave keeper's axe for digging -- and for the ones who dig.

grave_wardens_coat.name: Grave-Warden's Coat
grave_wardens_coat.desc: A long coat of grave-steel scales. +340 max HP.

lotus_disciple_robe.name: Lotus Disciple's Robe
lotus_disciple_robe.desc: White silk with a lotus at the breast. Every disciple gets one; nobody sells one. +120 max HP, cultivate 10% faster.

abyssal_pearl.name: Abyssal Pearl
abyssal_pearl.desc: A black pearl with a faint light inside.

coral_bone.name: Coral Bone
coral_bone.desc: Bone the coral grew through and replaced.

coral_trident_f11.name: Coral Trident
coral_trident_f11.desc: A three-pronged spear grown, not forged.

pearl_saber_f11.name: Pearl Saber
pearl_saber_f11.desc: A court blade with a pearl in the pommel.

nacre_scale_f11.name: Nacre Scale
nacre_scale_f11.desc: Mother-of-pearl scales, iridescent and hard. +396 max HP.

drowned_pill_f11.name: Tidal Pill
drowned_pill_f11.desc: Salty, deep, calming. +893 qi, and Water settles in you.

cloud_jade.name: Cloud Jade
cloud_jade.desc: Jade so light it floats if you let go.

immortal_dust.name: Immortal Dust
immortal_dust.desc: Dust from a palace that fell out of heaven.

celestial_sword_f13.name: Celestial Sword
celestial_sword_f13.desc: A sword from the palace armoury. It remembers flying.

cloudbreaker_halberd_f13.name: Cloudbreaker Halberd
cloudbreaker_halberd_f13.desc: A guardian's halberd, made to split storms.

immortal_s_vestment_f13.name: Immortal's Vestment
immortal_s_vestment_f13.desc: Robes that once walked in heaven. +468 max HP.

cloudruins_pill_f13.name: Heaven-Dew Pill
cloudruins_pill_f13.desc: Light as cloud, sweet as rain. +2176 qi, and Metal settles in you.

glowcap_spore.name: Glowcap Spore
glowcap_spore.desc: A pinch of glowing spores. Don't breathe them.

mycelium_thread.name: Mycelium Thread
mycelium_thread.desc: White threads stronger than they look.

sporecap_staff_f14.name: Sporecap Staff
sporecap_staff_f14.desc: A staff that grows a fresh cap every morning.

chitin_saber_f14.name: Chitin Saber
chitin_saber_f14.desc: A curved blade of beetle chitin, light and keen.

fungal_hide_f14.name: Fungal Hide
fungal_hide_f14.desc: Treated mushroom leather. It smells. It holds. +504 max HP.

fungal_pill_f14.name: Spore Tonic
fungal_pill_f14.desc: Earthy, bitter, alive. +3397 qi, and Wood settles in you.

storm_glass.name: Storm Glass
storm_glass.desc: Sand where lightning struck, fused into a twisted root.

thunder_iron.name: Thunder Iron
thunder_iron.desc: Iron that jolts your hand when you pick it up.

thunder_halberd_f16.name: Thunder Halberd
thunder_halberd_f16.desc: A halberd that crackles with a stored storm.

stormfang_dagger_f16.name: Stormfang Dagger
stormfang_dagger_f16.desc: A jagged blade like a frozen bolt.

lightning_rod_plate_f16.name: Lightning-Rod Plate
lightning_rod_plate_f16.desc: Plate armour that drinks lightning and sends it into the floor. +576 max HP.

storm_pill_f16.name: Thunder Pill
storm_pill_f16.desc: It makes your hair stand on end. +8277 qi, and Metal settles in you.

dragon_scale_shard.name: Dragon-Scale Shard
dragon_scale_shard.desc: A chip of a scale bigger than a door.

drake_blood.name: Drake Blood
drake_blood.desc: It burns the jar a little.

dragon_bone_halberd_f17.name: Dragon-Bone Halberd
dragon_bone_halberd_f17.desc: A halberd carved from a shed dragon's rib.

fang_saber_f17.name: Fang Saber
fang_saber_f17.desc: A saber made from a single drakeling fang.

drake_scale_mail_f17.name: Drake Scale Mail
drake_scale_mail_f17.desc: Mail of drake scales. Fire slides off it. +612 max HP.

dragonspine_pill_f17.name: Dragon-Blood Pill
dragonspine_pill_f17.desc: Hot enough to make your eyes water. +12920 qi, and Fire settles in you.

singing_crystal.name: Singing Crystal
singing_crystal.desc: A crystal that hums when your qi brushes it.

resonant_dust.name: Resonant Dust
resonant_dust.desc: Fine glittering dust that rings faintly when shaken.

crystal_spear_f19.name: Crystal Spear
crystal_spear_f19.desc: A spear of grown crystal; it sings when it strikes.

shardglass_dagger_f19.name: Shardglass Dagger
shardglass_dagger_f19.desc: A sliver of crystal sharpened to nothing at the edge.

prism_mail_f19.name: Prism Mail
prism_mail_f19.desc: Crystal scales that scatter a blow like light. +684 max HP.

crystal_pill_f19.name: Resonance Pill
crystal_pill_f19.desc: It hums all the way down. +31478 qi, and Water settles in you.

bloodsap.name: Bloodsap
bloodsap.desc: Red sap that clots like blood.

crimson_bark.name: Crimson Bark
crimson_bark.desc: Bark as hard as leather and as red as rust.

vinelash_spear_f12.name: Vinelash Spear
vinelash_spear_f12.desc: A spear wrapped in a living vine that grips your hand.

bloodbark_axe_f12.name: Bloodbark Axe
bloodbark_axe_f12.desc: An axe with a red-bark haft that drinks what it cuts.

bark_leather_f12.name: Bark-Leather
bark_leather_f12.desc: Crimson bark cured into leather. +432 max HP.

canopy_pill_f12.name: Bloodsap Pill
canopy_pill_f12.desc: Sweet, then iron. +1394 qi, and Wood settles in you.

ironroot_restorative_f15.name: Ironroot Hold Restorative
ironroot_restorative_f15.desc: A town remedy, made for the floors below. Heals 657 HP.

ironroot_elixir_f15.name: Ironroot Hold Qi Elixir
ironroot_elixir_f15.desc: Brewed for delvers going deeper. +6363 qi.

star_iron.name: Star Iron
star_iron.desc: Iron that fell from the sky. It is heavier than it should be.

meteor_glass.name: Meteor Glass
meteor_glass.desc: Green glass from the impact, full of tiny stars.

star_iron_sword_f18.name: Star-Iron Sword
star_iron_sword_f18.desc: A blade forged from a fallen star. It glows faintly at night.

meteor_hammer_f18.name: Meteor Hammer
meteor_hammer_f18.desc: A chunk of meteorite on a chain-wrapped haft.

star_iron_plate_f18.name: Star-Iron Plate
star_iron_plate_f18.desc: Plate of sky-metal. It turns more than blades. +648 max HP.

starmine_pill_f18.name: Starlight Pill
starmine_pill_f18.desc: It glitters on the tongue. +20166 qi, and Metal settles in you.

pagoda_restorative_f20.name: The Jade Pagoda Restorative
pagoda_restorative_f20.desc: A town remedy, made for the floors below. Heals 874 HP.

pagoda_elixir_f20.name: The Jade Pagoda Qi Elixir
pagoda_elixir_f20.desc: Brewed for delvers going deeper. +58961 qi.

practice_spear.name: Practice Spear
practice_spear.desc: Ash shaft, iron tip, a militia stamp on the butt. +6 damage, long reach.

hunting_knife.name: Hunting Knife
hunting_knife.desc: For skinning more than fighting -- in the right hands, both. +4 damage, fast.

woodcutters_axe.name: Woodcutter's Axe
woodcutters_axe.desc: Your father's, or someone's. +7 damage, heavy.

quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
quarterstaff.desc: A straight length of hardwood. +5 damage, good reach.

lodge_field_ration.name: Lodge Field Ration
lodge_field_ration.desc: Hard bread, harder cheese, a sip of something strong. Heals 70 HP. Lodge issue.

vanguard_token.name: Vanguard's Token
vanguard_token.desc: A dented bronze disc the Lodge gives those who walk in front. You take 5% less damage.

pathfinder_compass.name: Pathfinder's Compass
pathfinder_compass.desc: Its needle points at whatever's hidden nearest. Spirit sense reaches 4m further; a little more from every gather.

champions_brand.name: Champion's Brand
champions_brand.desc: The Lodge's mark, burned into a leather cuff. +6% damage, 3% faster strikes.

wild_tonic.name: Wild Tonic
wild_tonic.desc: Seven roots and a secret. Heals 40 HP and gives 40 qi.

forager_gloves.name: Forager's Gloves
forager_gloves.desc: Soft leather, worn through at the fingertips by someone else first. More from every gather.

warden_satchel.name: Warden's Satchel
warden_satchel.desc: A Warden of the Wild's own bag. One more of everything you gather.

guild_whetstone.name: Guild Whetstone
guild_whetstone.desc: Fine-grit, guild-cut. Your edge stays keener: +4% damage.

master_tongs.name: Master's Tongs
master_tongs.desc: Black iron, perfectly balanced. Finer and surer smithing.

furnace_charm.name: Furnace Charm
furnace_charm.desc: A clay token that keeps a furnace's heat honest. Surer alchemy.

refiners_lens.name: Refiner's Lens
refiners_lens.desc: See the impurity before it ruins the batch. Finer pills, and a little more qi from everything.

house_salve.name: House Salve
house_salve.desc: The Healers' own recipe. Heals 110 HP.

ward_charm.name: Ward Charm
ward_charm.desc: A knot of red thread blessed in the wards. Each foe you fell mends you a little.

saints_rosary.name: Saint's Rosary
saints_rosary.desc: Smooth beads, worn by a hundred prayers. Less damage taken, more life to take it.

lotus_seal.name: Lotus Seal
lotus_seal.desc: An Inner Disciple's seal. Your cultivation runs 6% richer.

sparring_manual.name: Sparring Manual
sparring_manual.desc: Margins full of a Core Disciple's notes. Quicker, harder strikes.

elders_jade_slip.name: Elder's Jade Slip
elders_jade_slip.desc: A True Disciple's privilege: an elder's own cultivation notes. Meditation and qi both run richer.

brass_cog.name: Brass Cog
brass_cog.desc: A perfect little cog that still turns on its own.

oil_of_motion.name: Oil of Motion
oil_of_motion.desc: Oil that makes anything it touches want to move.

piston_hammer_f21.name: Piston Hammer
piston_hammer_f21.desc: A hammer with a piston in the head. It hits twice.

spring_blade_f21.name: Spring-Blade
spring_blade_f21.desc: A blade on a spring that leaps out of your hand -- and back.

gearplate_f21.name: Gearplate
gearplate_f21.desc: Interlocking plates that shift to meet a blow. +756 max HP.

clockwork_pill_f21.name: Escapement Pill
clockwork_pill_f21.desc: Tick, tick, tick, all the way down. +76694 qi, and Metal settles in you.

spirit_silk.name: Spirit Silk
spirit_silk.desc: Silk that holds qi like a cup holds water.

lore.text: The same sac, cut with thistle, numbs instead of burns.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.desc: Draws a poison out and keeps you clean of new ones for four minutes. Heals 20 HP.

lore.text: Charred bone drinks poison; the herb mends what it touched.
